div.head: Abt 64.1
div.ab: Gif he þurhstinð, VI scill' gebete.
Gif he þurhstinð, VI scill' gebete.
Gif he þurhstinð, VI sciƚƚ gebete.
Wenn er es durchsticht, büsse er 6 Schill. [für die zweite Öffnung].
If he stabs through it, let him pay 6 shillings [for the second opening].
If he pierces it right through, he shall pay 6 shillings compensation.
If he stabs through [it], let him pay [with] 6 shillings.

note.seg: Vgl. Gl Gliederbussen 8A. Doppelt büsst zweimündige Wunde u. 67. Der Betrag aber scheint gegenüber 64 merkwürdig klein. Ist etwas (wie 49¹) ausgefallen, das von einem anderen Gliede handelte?

Cf. Gl Gliederbussen 8A. A wound with two openings is compensated double below 67. The amount, however, seems strangely small compared with 64. Has something dropped out here (as at 49¹) that dealt with another limb?
note.note: No number in vol. I or III: the note is on the clause as a whole.
